description: Take a Claude Code account off the list. Not the default account, the global one, nor one a switch waits to make global. Claude Code panes on its folder keep running. With delete_files, its folder (sign-in, history of its own) is deleted too, never what its links point at; refused while Claude Code runs on it.

delete_files.description: Delete its folder too (default false: the folder stays where it was).
